reviewed_sources.title: Supergravity spectrum on AdS2 x S2
reviewed_sources.read_this_continuation: PDF pages 9-11: sections 3.5-3.7, including massive tensor constraint, exceptional l=0/l=1 sectors, equation (3.38) reconstruction and boundary-mode qualification. The full bosonic section 3 was read in the previous source audit.
reviewed_sources.used_result: The physical l=1 scalar has mass squared six in unit AdS radius; separate boundary modes must not be discarded by an unexamined boundary gauge choice.
reviewed_sources.independent_check: Direct four-dimensional linear Einstein-Maxwell contraction for h_ab=4aYg_ab and delta A=a sin(theta)^2 dphi; all components vanish upon (Box-6)a=0.
reviewed_sources.not_reviewed_or_imported: Fermionic spectrum, representation-theory conclusions and supergravity proof dependencies are not imported. This is not a complete review of every result in the paper.

reviewed_sources.title: Dipole Perturbations of the Reissner-Nordstrom Solution: The Polar Case
reviewed_sources.read_this_continuation: All 15 main-text PDF pages and reference page 16. Reviewed the linearized RN equations, separated radial constraints, dipole decoupling, general decoupling, full metric/Maxwell reconstruction and exceptional dipole discussion (equations 4-99).
reviewed_sources.proof_dependency_review: Tracked the loss of an independent dipole gravitational equation and the resulting single physical second-order master. Read equations 35-42 and 84-99 with the reconstruction constraints. Reading the full derivation is not an independent symbolic verification of every formula.
reviewed_sources.used_result: Polar RN dipole dynamics and metric/Maxwell reconstruction predate this calculation. Equations (40), (41) and (87) yield V=Delta/r^5 [2M-2Q^2/r+6M W], W=3M Delta/(r varpi^2)+M/varpi, varpi=3M-2Q^2/r.
reviewed_sources.independent_check: At M=Q=P, checked lim(r->P) V/f=6/P^2 and static indicial exponents 2 and -3. The full Burko reconstruction and its mapping by electromagnetic duality into our magnetic gauge are not independently verified here.
upstream_not_fully_reviewed: Chandrasekhar, The Mathematical Theory of Black Holes (1983), underlying linearized equations and reconstruction method
Chandrasekhar and collaborators' RN perturbation papers listed in references 1-2
Moncrief and Zerilli RN perturbation papers listed in reference 2
reviewed_sources.novelty_implication: Neither the physical RN dipole mode nor existence of a metric/Maxwell reconstruction is new. Exclusions of l=1 from later papers do not establish novelty.

reviewed_sources.used_result: This version does not supply a gauge-fixed l=1 calculation; it recognizes the established exceptional mass-six mode.
reviewed_sources.not_imported: No complete matching theorem, quantum closure or stability result is imported from this partial reading.
